notes.semetey-1-2013:p0351:b004:l004: Present instruction to bring Manas's surviving dog Kumayyk, repeatedly described as his bequest, to Kanykey. No accusation of misconduct. Primary Yudakhin бет: кара бет sense 1 disgraced/publicly humiliated; sense 2 historically disgraced/unfortunate widow or bereaved bride, with an example also used by a wife reproached by her husband; sense 3 shameless/dishonest. The senses overlap: bereaved/unfortunate rendering does not erase the self-abasing association of shame. No complexion interpretation. Sources: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf; research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0353:b005:l008: Kanykey recalls the many guards she had while Manas was alive, contrasting them with destruction after his death.
